photo.credit: NASA · ISS Expedition 16 (2007). Sleep stations on station are personal closet-sized telephone-booths with a wall-anchored sleeping bag, ventilation fan, and personal lighting. The architecture is closer to a submarine bunk than a hotel room — privacy in microgravity is a designed-in luxury.
